name: @mikeargento/bitgraph
description: Portable proof that these exact bytes filled a position that existed before them.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/verify && npm run build --workspace=packages/audit && npm run build --workspace=packages/player && npm run build --workspace=packages/mcp && rm -rf dist && tsc
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/verify && npm run build --workspace=packages/audit && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/mcp && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:packages
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --prefix server/commit-service && npm run test:core
